whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Diva Restaurant & Cafe,

I noticed your restaurant has exceptional 4.8★ reviews in Sri Krishna Puri, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online table reservations and direct menu viewing.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, interactive food menu, aur special dining offers integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/diva

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Diva Restaurant & Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a digital menu, direct WhatsApp table booking, and mobile-first speed for Sri Krishna Puri patrons. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
